validation.cmd: sh -c 'p=$(tr "\n" " " < next/docs/progress.md | tr -s " "); for pr in 135 137 139 141; do echo "$p" | grep -qF "done** (merged #$pr; card closed" || { echo "PR $pr row not done with card closed"; exit 1; }; done; for id in os-c61c3392 os-cecac5de os-1dad487d os-0f718b4e; do echo "$p" | grep -q "$id" || { echo "$id missing"; exit 1; }; done; echo "$p" | grep -q "Phase 6 exit (the III.G subset" || { echo "exit paragraph missing"; exit 1; }; for bad in "(in progress)" "this PR" "pending"; do if echo "$p" | grep -qi "$bad"; then echo "stale marker: $bad"; exit 1; fi; done; exit 0'
